summary: Excellent, comprehensive specification that thoroughly covers diplomacy relationship mathematics. All required sections are present (Overview, Formulas, Constants, Algorithm, Data Tables, Edge Cases). All 4 JSON data blocks parse successfully. Formulas are implementation-ready with clear pseudocode algorithm. Properly uses pet-themed naming (Hamsters, Guinea Pigs, etc.) consistent with LORE.md. Minor inconsistencies with treaties.md should be reconciled but do not block implementation. The spec correctly maps MOO1 Human diplomacy traits to Hamsters and provides complete racial modifiers for all 10 races.
